questions.question: How quickly can we get started?
questions.answer: Once we've had our consultation call and confirmed the match, your VA will be fully onboarded and ready to work within **72 business hours**. We handle all the briefing and setup so you don't have to.

questions.question: Are your VAs bilingual?
questions.answer: Yes — all YVA professionals are fully bilingual in **English and Spanish**. This is a core part of who we are, allowing your firm to serve a broader client base without any language barriers.

questions.question: Is there a minimum hours commitment or contract?
questions.answer: We do have a service agreement, but there are **no long-term lock-ins**. You can exit at any time with no penalties or attachments. We believe our results should be the reason you stay — not a contract.

questions.question: What hours do your VAs work?
questions.answer: Our VAs are available **24/7 across U.S. time zones**, giving your firm around-the-clock coverage. YVA Law Staffing's administrative team operates **Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Eastern Time**.

questions.question: What tools and software do your VAs use?
questions.answer: Our VAs adapt to **whatever tools your firm already uses** — including Clio, MyCase, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace, and more. No switching, no disruption to your existing workflow.

questions.question: How is billing handled?
questions.answer: Services are billed hourly, starting at **$7.50/hr**. Payments are processed through **Zelle, Remitly, PayPal, or Payoneer** — whichever works best for you.

questions.question: What if the VA isn't a good fit?
questions.answer: No problem at all. Just let us know and we'll **match you with someone else** at no extra cost. We're committed to finding the right fit for your firm, not just filling a seat.

questions.question: Do you only work with law firms?
questions.answer: Law firms are our primary focus, but we also work with **professional services businesses and startups** that need bilingual virtual support. If you're unsure whether we're the right fit, just book a free call and we'll let you know honestly.
